stories.title: The small intestine microbiome: composition, host interactions and therapeutic potential
stories.authors_source: Nachman, Wozniak, Danhof et al.; Nature Reviews Microbiology (2026-11-10)
stories.takeaway: Synthesizes small-intestinal microbial ecology, host interactions and therapeutic opportunities.
stories.what_happened: Synthesizes small-intestinal microbial ecology, host interactions and therapeutic opportunities.
stories.method: Review of human small-intestine sampling, microbial composition and host-interaction literature.
stories.why_it_matters: Clarifies why stool-based observations cannot automatically represent the small bowel.
stories.read_first: Start with sampling limitations and region-specific ecology.
stories.caveat: Review, not a new interventional trial.

stories.title: Flow-dependent TGF-β1 secretion from HCT116 cells following constriction-based microfluidic passage
stories.authors_source: Mashhadi Keshtiban, Asgari, Kavand et al.; Scientific Reports (2026-11-10)
stories.takeaway: Investigates how microfluidic constriction and flow affect TGF-β1 release from HCT116 colorectal cells.
stories.what_happened: Investigates how microfluidic constriction and flow affect TGF-β1 release from HCT116 colorectal cells.
stories.method: Microfluidic constriction passage and TGF-β1/bioactivity measurements.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows why cell handling mechanics can alter biological assay readouts.
stories.read_first: Inspect flow controls, secretion normalization and cell viability.
stories.caveat: Cell-line passage is not equivalent to intact intestinal tissue physiology.

stories.title: An ulcerative colitis taxonomy defined by individual patient-reported response trajectories
stories.authors_source: Authors listed in primary publication; Nature Medicine (2026-11-09)
stories.takeaway: Patient-reported vedolizumab response trajectories were used to propose ulcerative-colitis response subtypes.
stories.what_happened: Patient-reported vedolizumab response trajectories were used to propose ulcerative-colitis response subtypes.
stories.method: Longitudinal patient-reported treatment-response trajectory analysis and molecular association.
stories.why_it_matters: Potential framework for studying response heterogeneity in intestinal disease.
stories.read_first: Check trajectory definitions, external validation and vascular-inflammation association.
stories.caveat: Proposed taxonomy and resistance hypothesis require independent validation.

stories.title: Opposing microbiome-mediated axes link modifiable lifestyles to health and chronic diseases
stories.authors_source: Authors listed in primary publication; Nature Medicine (2026-11-05)
stories.takeaway: Shotgun metagenomics of 6,803 adults identified opposing microbiome-linked lifestyle and disease axes, evaluated across external cohorts.
stories.what_happened: Shotgun metagenomics of 6,803 adults identified opposing microbiome-linked lifestyle and disease axes, evaluated across external cohorts.
stories.method: Population metagenomics, mediation analysis and independent-cohort prediction.
stories.why_it_matters: Provides a large-scale framework for microbiome–host epidemiology.
stories.read_first: Examine mediation assumptions, cohort composition and external validation.
stories.caveat: Observational mediation does not demonstrate causal benefit from altering microbes.

stories.title: Microbiota-based cholesterol metabolism intervention investigated for colorectal cancer
stories.takeaway: Investigates microbiota-mediated modulation of tumor cholesterol metabolism in colorectal cancer.
stories.what_happened: Investigates microbiota-mediated modulation of tumor cholesterol metabolism in colorectal cancer.
stories.why_it_matters: Connects microbial metabolic activity to intestinal cancer therapy hypotheses.
stories.read_first: Inspect controls linking microbial intervention to tumor cholesterol pathways.
stories.caveat: Clinical efficacy and safety have not been established.

stories.title: Microplastics inhibit macrophage bioenergetics impairing homeostatic function and immune responsiveness
stories.authors_source: Authors listed in primary publication; Scientific Reports (2026-11-09)
stories.takeaway: Examines how microplastic exposure changes pulmonary macrophage energy metabolism and immune responsiveness.
stories.what_happened: Examines how microplastic exposure changes pulmonary macrophage energy metabolism and immune responsiveness.
stories.method: Experimental microplastic exposure and macrophage bioenergetic/immune assays.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates mechanistic links between environmental exposure and immune-cell metabolism.
stories.read_first: Check exposure concentrations and bioenergetic measurements.
stories.caveat: Experimental exposures may not represent typical human exposure.

stories.title: The mammalian archaeome: diversity, function and emerging roles in health and disease
stories.authors_source: Kumpitsch, Bauer, Arora et al.; Nature Reviews Microbiology (2026-11-09)
stories.takeaway: Reviews mammalian archaeal diversity, methanogenic syntrophy and possible host-health relationships.
stories.what_happened: Reviews mammalian archaeal diversity, methanogenic syntrophy and possible host-health relationships.
stories.method: Cross-species literature synthesis focused on Methanobrevibacter and gastrointestinal ecology.
stories.read_first: Read sections on human sampling and evidence for disease associations.
stories.caveat: Associations and cross-species observations do not prove causal roles.

stories.title: The FMR1 isoform landscape reveals new spliced variants in women’s blood and ovarian tissues
stories.authors_source: Ingravidi, Fernández, Caviglia et al.; Scientific Reports (2026-11-10)
stories.takeaway: Reports alternative FMR1 transcript isoforms in blood and ovarian tissue.
stories.what_happened: Reports alternative FMR1 transcript isoforms in blood and ovarian tissue.
stories.why_it_matters: Demonstrates why transcript-level resolution matters beyond gene counts.
stories.read_first: Inspect isoform validation and tissue/sample coverage.
stories.caveat: Tissue-specific observations do not imply established functional effects.

stories.title: An AI-powered trisomy 21 Research Assistant
stories.authors_source: Nandi, Sundararajan, Subirana-Granés et al.; Scientific Reports (2026-11-10)
stories.takeaway: Introduces a literature-focused retrieval-augmented research assistant for trisomy 21.
stories.what_happened: Introduces a literature-focused retrieval-augmented research assistant for trisomy 21.
stories.method: Biomedical literature retrieval and language-model answer generation.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to traceable evidence synthesis across fast-moving biomedical literature.
stories.read_first: Check source-grounding, evaluation metrics and hallucination tests.
stories.caveat: Automated answers require independent primary-source verification.

stories.title: Randomized exercise trial measures gut microbiota changes in prediabetes
stories.authors_source: Authors listed in primary publication; Scientific Reports (2026-11-10)
stories.takeaway: A 64-person exercise trial reported higher microbial alpha-diversity after 12 weeks of HIIT than moderate continuous exercise.
stories.what_happened: A 64-person exercise trial reported higher microbial alpha-diversity after 12 weeks of HIIT than moderate continuous exercise.
stories.method: Randomized exercise comparison with 16S rRNA microbiota profiling.
stories.why_it_matters: Pairs a controlled lifestyle intervention with microbiome outcomes.
stories.read_first: Inspect baseline differences and multiple-testing adjustments.
stories.caveat: Exploratory 16S endpoints do not establish microbial mediation.
